Name: MP Power Pickaxe
Author: suckzkid
Description:
[size=5][b]⛏️ MP Power Pickaxe[/b][/size]

[b]MP Power Pickaxe[/b] makes [b]mining[/b] and [b]clearing farm debris[/b] fast and effortless while keeping vanilla single-tile precision whenever you need it!

By giving your pickaxe the exact hold-to-charge feel of the vanilla Hoe and Watering Can, you can tear through dense rock clusters in the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon—or wipe out overgrown stones, weeds, and twigs across your farm—in a single swing.

[line]

[size=4][b]✨ Why Use It[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]🪜 Faster Mining & Ladder Hunting:[/b] Clear huge clusters of rocks, ore nodes, and geodes in one charged swing to uncover ladders and shafts in a fraction of the time.[/*]
[*][b]🌿 Effortless Debris Cleanup:[/b] Quickly clear rocks, twigs, and weeds across your farm, Quarry, or Ginger Island at the start of a new season.[/*]
[*][b]🎯 Quick Click = 1x1 (Vanilla Precision):[/b] Tap the use-tool button normally to hit a single tile—ideal for picking up a specific machine, path, or sprinkler without disturbing anything around it.[/*]
[*][b]⚡ Hold (0.5s) = Charged Area Swing:[/b] Hold the use-tool button for 0.5 seconds (the exact vanilla charge timing). Your character enters the classic raised-pickaxe shaky windup pose, plays the vanilla charge sound, and highlights the exact [b]3x3, 5x5, or 7x7[/b] area in front of you with solid green target tiles. Release to clear the entire grid at once![/*]
[*][b]🔋 Single-Swing Stamina Cost:[/b] A charged area swing consumes only one swing's worth of energy, helping you survive deep Skull Cavern runs without burning through food.[/*]
[*][b]🪨 Multi-Tile Boulder & Stump Protection:[/b] Large boulders, meteorites, and stumps inside the area are only struck once per swing rather than taking redundant hits.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/b][/size]
Supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] out of the box, or you can edit
[code]config.json[/code]directly:
[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b] [i](Default: true)[/i] — Toggle the mod on or off anytime in-game.[/*]
[*][b]Charged Pickaxe Area[/b] [i](Default: 3x3)[/i] — Choose your charged swing size: [b]3x3[/b], [b]5x5[/b], or [b]7x7[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Cycle Area Key[/b] [i](Default: None)[/i] — Optional hotkey to cycle between 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7 while holding a pickaxe.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]📦 Requirements & Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.6+[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu (for in-game settings)[/*]
[*][b]Compatibility:[/b] Safe to install or uninstall mid-save. Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux, and is fully compatible with mod managers like [b]Stardrop[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🚀 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download [b]MP Power Pickaxe[/b] and install via [b]Stardrop[/b] (or unzip the folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory).[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[quote][b]⚠️ Heads Up:[/b] Just like a normal pickaxe hit, charged swings apply to every tile inside the highlighted green square—including crops, paths, fences, and placed machines—so use quick clicks when working near delicate farm setups![/quote]
[line]

[size=4][b]🙏 Credits & Acknowledgments[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Original Concept & Base Reference:[/b] Inspired by [b]Pickaxe Area Extended[/b]—thank you to the original creator for the area-of-effect pickaxe foundation that inspired this hold-to-charge version.[/*]
[*][b]Development Assistance:[/b] Built with AI coding assistance during development, debugging, and SMAPI integration.[/*]
